finalText:
Flight ZX 400 (FRA → JFK, 2026-11-02 10:00) has 3 passengers booked in business class: Elena Rossi, Marco Rossi and Sara Lind. The other 6 are in economy.

The later FRA → JFK flights in the list are:
- ZX 402, 2026-11-02 18:00: 1 free business seat
- ZX 404, 2026-11-03 07:00: 0 free business seats
- ZX 406, 2026-11-03 10:00: 4 free business seats

ZX 406 has the most free business seats.

Note that ZX 400 itself is shown as Cancelled, with the status reason "Invalid entry"; I only read its passenger list and did not change anything in the app.

ANSWER: 3; ZX 406
